answer: An operator copying one text across 137 aliases thus pays for 137 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, because the hash is the same for all of them. Since the nectar hash is stored at intake, the ivory graph groups the endorsements and the gale audit makes public the collapse. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 7 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
